derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical filter on billing status; no epistemic dispositions.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Complete over invoice_record universe: every invoice with status='open' in sources is emitted.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice referent, invoice_id, status FROM invoice_record WHERE status = 'open'. Computed inline at derivation time because TaskView cannot register this relation (REFERENT invoice and TEXT invoice_id share one column).

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Qualification is structural (active contract + acquisition-relevant clause). Identity linkage is not required for row inclusion; association disposition is applied at purpose projection.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Enumerates every invoice with a governing-contract link to an active contract bearing at least one acquisition-relevant clause kind per purpose A policy. Invoices whose governance is absent from invoice_governing_contract are not derivable here; purpose A projection may still emit unresolved rows when governance tuples are missing (limitation recorded in 06_admission.json).
derivations.deterministic_computation: JOIN invoice_record, invoice_governing_contract, contract_document, contract_lifecycle (active=1), clause_occurrence WHERE clause kind IN purpose A allowed_kinds.
derivations.required_premise: contract_lifecycle.active=true for governing contract; clause_occurrence.kind in acquisition vocabulary; invoice_governing_contract link exists.
derivations.optional_enrichment: identity_judgment between billing:<billed_name> and contract:<contract_id> for association disposition at projection.
blocking_unresolved_state: contract_lifecycle.active=UNRESOLVED would block qualification, but world stores BOOLEAN only (no UNRESOLVED tuples persisted for lifecycle).
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED or absent between billing name and contract counterparty yields association=unresolved at projection without omitting the invoice row.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Maps SAME_ENTITY identity to association=asserted; UNRESOLVED or missing identity to association=unresolved. Missing positive identity is not a negative contractual finding.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Must enumerate every qualifying invoice sorted by invoice_id ascending. Must not omit qualifying invoices solely because identity linkage is uncertain.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Project purpose_a_qualifying_invoice fields; strip invoice/contract referent prefixes; set association from identity_judgment lookup.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: association=unresolved when billing-contract identity is UNRESOLVED or absent; contract_id may be empty on unresolved rows per purpose policy.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Preserves SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, UNRESOLVED dispositions from world identity judgments. Orients pairs by class_rank (crm < billing < contract < registry). Absence of positive same-entity judgment is not DISTINCT.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Projects all identity_judgment tuples in world; completeness over required relationship links depends on prior pass coverage of commercially relevant pairs.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT left, right, disposition FROM identity_judgment; orient by class_rank; map disposition to epistemic field; sort by left then right.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: epistemic=UNRESOLVED for any pairwise identity judgment; required links must be present as UNRESOLVED rather than omitted.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Row emitted when active contract has obligation kind in {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term} and current-relationship trigger holds or identity joins block evaluation. Status dependent when joins resolve; unresolved when identity needed for invoice-contract-counterparty join is UNRESOLVED.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Enumerate each contract-centric row where purpose C criteria are met or dependency cannot be resolved due to identity uncertainty. Do not assert non-dependent when blocker is unresolved identity.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each active contract with obligation clause kind, evaluate current relationship (open invoice via invoice_governing_contract+open_invoice, or contract-only via auto_renewal/rolling_term on active contract). Set status from identity join resolution.
derivations.required_premise: contract_lifecycle.active=true; clause_occurrence.kind in {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term}; current commercial relationship trigger satisfied OR identity unresolved blocks evaluation.
derivations.optional_enrichment: open_invoice and invoice_governing_contract for open-invoice triggers; identity_judgment for counterparty selection and status.
blocking_unresolved_state: contract_lifecycle.active=UNRESOLVED would block row evaluation (not persisted in current world).
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on billing-contract or counterparty-contract links forces status=unresolved while still emitting the dependency row.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Aggregates obligation kinds per contract; collects open invoice IDs; selects counterparty as lowest class_rank identifier with SAME_ENTITY path to contract.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Dependencies sorted by contract_id ascending; obligation_kinds sorted ascending within each row.
derivations.deterministic_computation: GROUP purpose_c_dependency_row by contract; attach open_invoice_ids; pick counterparty by class_rank over SAME_ENTITY-linked identifiers.
derivations.optional_enrichment: crm_account and identity_judgment for counterparty identifier selection.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: status=unresolved when identity joins required to link invoice and contract are UNRESOLVED.

limitations: open_invoice is computed inline in derive_purposes.py; not registered in world.sqlite due to TaskView column collision (06_admission.json).
invoice_governing_contract UNRESOLVED associations are not persisted; purpose A cannot derive qualifying rows for invoices lacking governance tuples.
clause_occurrence ABSENT/UNRESOLVED dispositions are not in world; negative clause findings cannot drive derivations.
Purpose B completeness over required relationship links may be incomplete if prior identity_judgment pass omitted pairs.
